description: This file defines the IControlClient interface, an abstract class in the firebolt::rialto namespace. It declares a destructor and a pure virtual method notifyApplicationState, which is used to notify clients of changes in the application state of the rialto server.

classes.name: IControlClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for Rialto control clients, providing an interface for notification callbacks about application state changes.

methods.name: ~IControlClient
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the IControlClient class.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Pure virtual method to notify the client of a new application state.
